output: html_document

```{r}
library(dplyr)
#load in the masterdoc
master <- read_csv("badwords_masterdoc.csv") %>% 
  select(1)
#this contains 3854 words
#remove duplicates
master_unique <- unique(master) %>% 
  rename(spaces = 1)
#down to 3186 words
#now create one with no spaces
unique_nospace <- as.data.frame(apply(master_unique, 2, function(x) gsub('\\s+', '', x))) %>% 
  rename(nospace = 1)
#merge them together
total <- cbind(master_unique, unique_nospace)
#remove any where without spaces it is longer than 7
total_filtered <- total %>% 
  filter(nchar(spaces) < 8)
#down to 1629! 
#we just need to put her in python and remove all of the odd things! 

write.csv(total_filtered, file = "uniqueevilmasterdoc.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
